notes.title: Publish or Perish Anniversary! Version 1.05 Update.
notes.content:
Hello all,

Publish or Perish has now been Published for exactly one year! To celebrate, we published a little update. 

Version 1.05 changelog:
[list]
[*] Added an end screen when finishing a game. 
[*] Rebalanced difficulty and funding 
[*] Updated the card selection screen
[*] Added randomized *sketchy* academic emails
[*] Updated various visuals (e.g. increased contrast)
[*] Added an export citation button (the game is about publishing papers after all).
[/list]

Let us know what you would like to see in version 1.06!

Happy publishing! 

The Tapped Mango Team
